headline: SITCON 2 (SEVERE): France blames Iran for refrigeration attacks; Chrome zero-day CVE-2026-125350 and OpenSSH SSHole exploited; N-central offline

bullets.text: Changed: France has blamed Iran for cyberattacks on refrigerators and freezers in supermarkets and blood banks, some reported to have caused fires. Now a developing situation across 3 outlets. SITCON holds at 2 (SEVERE) on 4 CISA KEV additions in 72 hours and 3 critical reports in 48 hours.
Google's Chrome security update fixes CVE-2026-125350, the eighth actively exploited Chrome zero-day of 2026.
N-able's hosted N-central cloud remains the subject of a disclosure of 33 zero-days with proof-of-concept exploits; N-able took the platform offline in response.

SSHole (OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158, an authentication bypass) is still being used to breach Linux systems, covered by 6 outlets. In CISA KEV since 11-09 alongside GPUStack CVE-2026-102895, FreeSwitch CVE-2026-116779 and IBM Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218; all four are due 11-12.

Changed: Fireworks AI disclosed a new breach following a hack of its cloud provider. It joins this week's cloud trust abuse: attackers used Qubole's trusted AWS access to breach customer accounts, and a separate report describes backdoored AWS integrations stealing secrets.

Still developing: Ethersphere's bee-js and Swarm Desktop compromised to deliver wallet-stealing malware; 300 malicious packages listed in the GitHub Advisory Database in 7 days, mostly npm; Vanderbilt ransomware and the Beget wiper attack. The last 7 days ran 0.84x the 90-day average.

actions: Update Chrome on all endpoints to the latest release (fixes CVE-2026-125350) and restart browsers; confirm managed fleets picked it up.
Patch OpenSSH for CVE-2026-123158 on every internet-facing host; restrict SSH exposure and review auth logs for unexpected logins.
Patch or isolate GPUStack (CVE-2026-102895), FreeSwitch (CVE-2026-116779) and IBM Aspera Faspex (CVE-2026-123218) before the 11-12 KEV deadline.
N-central users: plan for the hosted outage, limit network exposure of N-central servers and agents, and watch N-able for fixes.
Audit IAM roles that trust third-party AWS accounts; remove unused integrations such as Qubole and rotate secrets they could reach.
Check that refrigeration and other building-control systems are not reachable from the internet; VMware ESX CVE-2026-41709 is due in KEV 11-11.
